mapper.select: SELECT legacy_source_id id,domain_status status,JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.precisionRate') precision_rate,JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.recallRate') recall_rate,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.routingOutcome')) routing_outcome,user_id assessed_by,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.approvedBy')) AS UNSIGNED) approved_by,created_at assessed_at,completed_at approved_at FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='ALERT_ACCEPTANCE' AND rule_id=#{id} ORDER BY legacy_source_id DESC LIMIT 1
